canonicalization.decimal: exact Decimal, fixed schema scale, precision=60 during quantize, no float conversion

canonicalization.strings: UTF-8 preserved without trimming or Unicode normalization
canonicalization.nested: schema-ordered struct fields and list order preserved
canonicalization.row_hash: SHA256 compact typed-schema JSON values in column order
canonicalization.partition_hash: SHA256(schema+partition prefix, then binary-key-ordered length-prefixed key and row SHA256); independent native/Trino streams
canonicalization.disk_matching: SQLite WITHOUT ROWID exact canonical key PRIMARY KEY, one received row per native key, batch 1024, cache 8 MiB, temp_store FILE
